sleep.title: Mercure Xi’an International Airport
sleep.text: Mercure Xi’an International Airport is at Yingbin Road 15 in Weicheng District, Xianyang. The hotel has 104 rooms, a fitness centre, a laundry room, a restaurant and free parking. Check-in starts at 12:00 and check-out is by 12:00; phone: +86 29 38195566.
